audit_items.proof_trace: The blob_sidecars_by_range handler serves blobs from ANY slot including Fulu-era slots. Neither validateBlobsByRange nor streamBlobBatch enforce the required slot < FULU_FORK_EPOCH restriction, violating the protocol specification that this RPC is deprecated post-Fulu.
audit_items.attack_scenario: After Fulu fork activation, any P2P peer sends BlobSidecarsByRangeRequest with StartSlot >= FULU_FORK_SLOT. The handler serves Fulu-era blobs instead of rejecting or capping the range to pre-Fulu slots, violating protocol transition requirements.
